initiatives.name: Food Bank of Alaska
initiatives.description: Statewide food bank headquartered in Anchorage. Runs food pantries, mobile services and programs for children and seniors, and delivers food to rural Alaska communities.

initiatives.name: Mutual Aid Network of Anchorage (MANA)
initiatives.description: Anchorage mutual aid network that matches neighbors who need help with local volunteers for grocery delivery, wellness checks, yard work, and navigating social services.
